name: react-bits
description: High-performance visual effects components using WebGL and Three.js for creating stunning interactive experiences
author: JasonJS Framework

ASCIIText.description: Animated 3D text rendered as ASCII art with WebGL effects, mouse interaction, and dynamic hue rotation

ColorBends.description: Fluid, morphing color patterns with shader effects. Supports custom colors, rotation, mouse parallax, and various warp effects

Dither.description: Retro dithered wave effect with Bayer matrix post-processing, Perlin noise waves, and mouse interaction

ASCIIText.example: <ASCIIText text="Hello" asciiFontSize={8} textFontSize={200} textColor="#fdf9f3" planeBaseHeight={8} enableWaves={true} />

asciiFontSize.description: Font size for the ASCII characters

textFontSize.description: Font size for the source text texture

ColorBends.example: <ColorBends colors={['#FF6188', '#FC9867', '#FFD866']} rotation={45} speed={0.2} transparent={true} warpStrength={1} mouseInfluence={1} />

colors.description: Array of hex color strings (max 8 colors). Empty array uses default RGB effect

Dither.example: <Dither waveColor={[0.2,0.7,1]} disableAnimation={false} enableMouseInteraction={true} mouseRadius={0.9} colorNum={2.5} waveAmplitude={0.65} waveFrequency={0} waveSpeed={0.03} />

colorNum.description: Number of dither color levels. Lower values = more retro

mouseRadius.description: Radius of the mouse interaction effect

Use 1-2 per page maximum. 2. **Mobile**: Consider disabling or using simpler settings on mobile devices 3. **Lazy Loading**: Load these components only when visible 4. **Cleanup**: Components handle cleanup automatically - no manual intervention needed ## Troubleshooting **Component not visible:** - Check parent has explicit width/height - Verify parent has position: relative or absolute - For ASCIIText, ensure background is dark enough **Performance issues:** - Reduce frequency and warpStrength - Lower asciiFontSize for ASCIIText - Disable autoRotate - Use fewer colors in ColorBends **WebGL errors:** - Ensure Three.js is installed: `npm install three` - Check browser supports WebGL - Test if multiple WebGL contexts are being created ## Design Tips 1. **ASCIIText**: Works best with short text (1-2 words). Longer text becomes harder to read. 2. **ColorBends**: Use as backgrounds, not main content. Always have content layered above it. 3. **Color Harmony**: Match colors to your brand palette for cohesive design. 4. **Subtlety**: Lower speed values (0.1-0.3) feel more premium than fast animations. 5. **Contrast**: Ensure text over effects has sufficient contrast for readability. 6. **Dither**: Great for retro/lo-fi aesthetics. Use low colorNum (2-3) for maximum dither effect, higher (6-8) for subtle texture. ## When NOT to Use - Accessibility-critical sections (effects can be distracting) - Content-heavy pages (interferes with reading) - Forms or input areas (can be distracting) - Mobile-first projects with limited GPU (consider static alternatives) - Professional/corporate sites requiring conservative design Remember: These components are statement pieces. Use them strategically to create impact, not on every page element.
